verdicts.reason: A has a sound top-to-bottom story stack (brand, headline, large hero circle). But the CTA 'Find It Near You' has shrunk to a tiny pill the same size as the badges, so it is buried in a row of four, and body copy now sits below the CTA, which breaks the reading order. B is broken: the hero product is shrunk into the top-right corner, the headline floats mid-left beside scattered pills, and there are large dead gaps. The CTA is tiny, badges and body copy are strewn down the right column, and the layout has no grid or grouping.
